export function normalizeStatus(value) {
  const s = String(value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (s === 'passed' || s === 'ok' || s === 'success') return 'pass';
  if (s === 'failed' || s === 'error') return 'fail';
  if (INCOMPLETE_STATUSES.includes(s)) return s;
  return 'missing';
}
